The centerpiece of the innings was a brilliant 212 from Rohit Sharma, complemented by a commanding 267-run stand between Ajinkya Rahane and Rohit Sharma that absorbed bowling hostility and accelerated the scoring rate to 4.26 RPO. South Africa's bowling response was spearheaded by GF Linde (4/133), who generated sustained pressure and triggered critical breakthroughs to prevent runaway scoring. Finishing at 497/9 (116.3 ov), India established an overwhelming first-innings foundation that firmly dictated the terms of the match.

summaryTab.matchCommentary:
The Test match at JSCA International Stadium Complex commenced with high tactical intensity as India posted 497/9 (116.3 ov) in their opening innings. In response, South Africa countered with 162/10 (56.2 ov), setting the stage for a compelling contest of tactical endurance. Early sessions tested batting resolve against disciplined seam movement, with both attacks striving to gain the upper hand on a developing surface.

The defining turning point arrived during Century: Rohit Sharma 212 (255b), which irrevocably altered the trajectory of the match. As the match progressed through its pivotal middle stages, Rohit Sharma delivered a masterclass for India (212 Runs), absorbing intense pressure and tilting the momentum decisively. Crucial partnership stands and incisive bowling spells broke the opposition's resistance, shifting the control share (India 66%) and allowing India to dictate terms heading into the decisive sessions.

Entering the final innings, South Africa faced an uphill battle under unrelenting scoreboard pressure. India's bowling unit, bolstered by UT Yadav (31 Runs & 6 Wkts), maintained relentless discipline and attacked the stumps relentlessly. Wicket clusters in the closing sessions dismantled any remaining resistance, sealing India won by innings & 202 runs in comprehensive fashion.

Verdict: India's triumph was built on superior pressure absorption, clinical execution during critical moments, and the ability to dominate key sessions. While South Africa produced fighting phases, India won the pivotal turning points and sustained higher tactical control across all five days to emerge as deserved victors.
